methodologyNotes: Self-serve USD pricing collected from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible on 2026-06-14. Zoom's pricing page (zoom.us/pricing/events) renders JS-only and returned empty content; Zapier's best-webinar-software guide (Dec 2025) was used as primary source for Zoom with corroboration from the GetApp listing. GoTo Webinar's official pricing page (goto.com/webinar/pricing) returned HTTP 403; GetApp and SoftwareAdvice listings were used instead, both confirming the same per-user figures. Livestorm's official page serves EUR pricing; GetApp was used for USD amounts. All non-telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan. annualDiscountPct is populated only when both monthly and annual rates appear in the same source. Quote-only/enterprise tiers carry monthlyUsd: null and billingModel: 'custom'.

vendors.name: Zoom Webinars
vendors.provenance: Official page zoom.us/pricing/events renders JS-only (blank payload on fetch, 2026-06-14). Prices sourced from Zapier 'Best Webinar Software' guide (published 2025-12-22, URL: https://zapier.com/blog/best-webinar-software/) stating '$66.67/month/license billed annually for up to 300 attendees'. Corroboration via GetApp listing at https://www.getapp.com/conference-management-software/a/zoom-webinars/pricing/ (returned 404; SoftwareAdvice listing also 404). Zapier figure is the only independently retrieved USD data point; higher attendee tiers exist but prices were not accessible from any non-JS source.

plans.name: Webinars 300 (Annual)
plans.notes: Entry tier — up to 300 attendees, unlimited webinars, billed annually. Month-to-month rate not confirmed from accessible sources. Higher attendee tiers (500, 1000, 3000, 5000, 10000+) available; prices not retrievable from non-JS sources.

plans.name: Webinars 500+ (Quote)
plans.notes: Attendee tiers above 300 (500, 1000, 3000, 5000, 10000) exist on zoom.us but prices could not be retrieved from accessible (non-JS) sources on 2026-06-14.

vendors.name: Demio
vendors.provenance: Official pricing page demio.com/pricing fetched 2026-06-14 (Starter monthly confirmed at $63; Growth monthly confirmed at placeholder '$/mo' on raw page). GetApp listing https://www.getapp.com/content-management-software/a/demio/pricing/ returned complete figures: Starter $63/mo or $534/yr, Growth $117/mo or $962/yr, Premium $2354/yr, Unlimited $23540/yr. Premium monthly rate not published; annual-only billing confirmed.

plans.name: Starter Monthly
plans.notes: 1 host, 50 attendees per event, 3-hour session limit. Month-to-month billing.

plans.name: Starter Annual
plans.notes: $534/year ($44.50/month effective). 1 host, 50 attendees per event, 3-hour session limit. Zapier guide cites $45/month billed annually (minor rounding).

plans.name: Growth Monthly
plans.notes: 1 host at base price (additional hosts billed separately). Attendee options: 150, 500, 1000, or 3000 per event. 8-hour session limit. Automated events, custom branding.

plans.name: Growth Annual
plans.notes: $962/year ($80.17/month effective). 1 host at base price; attendee tiers 150–3000. 8-hour session limit.

plans.name: Premium Annual
plans.notes: $2354/year ($196.17/month effective); no monthly billing option published. Unlimited hosts per account, attendee tiers 150–3000, 10-hour session limit, dedicated account manager, HubSpot/Salesforce/Marketo integrations.

plans.name: Unlimited Annual
plans.notes: $23540/year ($1961.67/month effective); annual billing only. SSO, unlimited hosts, premium support.

vendors.name: Livestorm

Corroborated by Zapier guide (Dec 2025) citing '$105/month billed annually'. Business and Enterprise prices are not publicly listed on any accessible source.

plans.name: Enterprise
